entities.name: Elsha
entities.description: Djinn monk of the Jeskai Way on Tarkir, master of all three Jeskai schools.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord whose rule Elsha's rebels overthrew.

entities.name: Sage-Eye Stronghold
entities.description: Stronghold where Elsha was head abbot in the original timeline.

events.summary: Frustrated with her teachers, Elsha joins the rebels and fights to overthrow Ojutai.
events.quote: fought alongside them to overthrow Ojutai

events.summary: In the original timeline Elsha is the first djinni to become head abbot of the Sage-Eye Stronghold.
events.quote: Elsha was the first-ever djinni to earn the title of head abbot

relations.quote: Elsha mentored the aven monk Xho Cai
Elsha is a djinn monk from the Jeskai Way on Tarkir
